summary: Produced the invoice/tax/reversal contract-freeze ADR at docs/adr/0015-invoice-tax-contract.md (docs-only, no code/migration/schema change), using the exact BASE whitelist filename rather than the alternative name mentioned in the assignment. The ADR cites the existing canonical contract facts (Invoice/InvoiceLine/InvoiceAllocation/InvoiceReversal/TaxQualification entities; invoicing.invoice.record/v1, invoicing.lines.allocate/v1, invoicing.invoice.reverse/v1 commands; recorded/allocated/reversed events) and the delivered upstream capabilities (contracts PH-214/265/287, settlement PH-224/232, management_revenue PH-284). It freezes: private draft workflow vs canonical status semantics (record -> active, posted reserved for later accounting, reversed only as an append-only full-reversal status bit, superseded requires a later planning slice); gross=net+tax integer-cent arithmetic with row/sum conservation, ROUND_HALF_UP residual absorption and snapshot tax rates; tax qualification pending/unknown cost treatment and open-period recoverable/not_recoverable correction by the costing owner; append-only negative InvoiceReversal (amounts never edited, red offset is not a refund, revenue/cash stay with their owners); idempotency/org lock/invoice-number uniqueness; role matrix and module-disabled history read; the relation to PH-252 (remains the sole proposed implementation slice; this ADR does not authorize implementation) and read-only integration points for later overview/export slices. PH-252's spec and blocker were synced to point at the ADR without promoting it.

review.reviewer: independent PH-293 invoice/tax ADR reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - partial-reversal status contradicts the frozen state machine: ADR 0015 says the only initial canonical status after `invoicing.invoice.record/v1` is `active`, `posted` is reserved for a future accounting/tax action and is not produced by PH-252, yet section 3 says a partial reversal leaves the original invoice status `posted`. A partial reversal of an `active` invoice must keep it `active` (with the append-only InvoiceReversal and derived remaining), not move it to a status the first slice never produces. Fix: state partial reversal leaves the original at `active` (or, if `posted` is intentionally produced, define that transition and its accounting prerequisite); align the red-reversal wording with the canonical status enum and add the explicit transition table (draft private -> active on record, active -> reversed on full reversal, partial reversal status unchanged).

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: the ADR's canonical references match entities.schema.json - Invoice required fields/status enum draft/active/posted/reversed/superseded, direction sales/purchase, InvoiceLine/Allocation/Reversal fields and InvoiceReversal SignedCnyCents, TaxQualification status pending/confirmed/superseded + qualification unknown/recoverable/not_recoverable; gross=net+tax, integer cents, ROUND_HALF_UP last-item rounding, tax-rate snapshot without inference, pending input tax treated as cost and sales tax excluded from revenue, append-only negative reversal <= un-reversed amount, original never edited, red invoice != refund, company lock/request_token/invoice_number duplicate/audit/no half-write, five-role matrix + history_read, and PH-252 remains the only proposed write slice are all frozen. Number 0015 is free (leaf 0014; 0016/0017 planned for close ADRs); files are ADR + PH-252 spec + tasks/manifest/docs/verification/report/handoff within the 8-path whitelist; no code/migration/schema/canonical topic; PH-293 in_review/handoff and PH-252 blocker points to ADR 0015 while remaining proposed. check ok=245; governance 23 OK; verify-change --base 15cf20c --task PH-293 only high_risk_review_required, no path_out_of_scope.
